title: A Noetherian integral separated scheme of dimension 1 has an ample invertible sheaf
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The proof takes a finite affine cover whose complements are finite (Noetherian of dimension 1), produces for each piece a globally generated pair (L_i, s_i) with U_i = X_{s_i} via the delivered find-globally-generated lemma, and concludes by the delivered enough-globally-generated-ample lemma. H2: three-step composition of two delivered companions; the observation that the complements X \ U_i are finite is the connective tissue.
